description:
Activate [[Free Sac Outlet]] by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Crime Novelist and Krenko trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on the Crime Novelist.
Resolve the Krenko trigger, Paying {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield, attached to the Goblin token.
[[Free Sac Outlet]] triggers, untapping [[Free Sac Outlet]].
Resolve the [[Free Sac Outlet]] trigger from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
